have_account: Already have an account? Sign in
pending_text: Your account {{address}} is created. An administrator needs to approve it before you can sign in.
pending_key_note: Your private key was created on this device and never leaves it. Sign in here after approval, or restore a key backup to use another device.
import_key_text: Use the backup file you downloaded from Account on your other device, then sign in.
passphrase_hint: At least 10 characters. MailChat can't recover it if you forget it.
missing_key_title: Your key isn't on this device
missing_key_text: You're signed in as {{address}}, but the private key needed to read your messages lives on the device where you registered. Restore a key backup to use MailChat here.
your_address_hint: Your chat address. Others start a chat with you by typing it, or just your login.
chat_empty: Messages here are end-to-end encrypted. Say hi!
copied_encrypted: Encrypted message copied. Paste it into any app that works.
open_text: Paste an encrypted MAILCHAT MESSAGE block you received through another app, or the link from the email.
install_title: Add MailChat to your Home Screen
install_ios_text: To get notifications on iPhone, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and open MailChat from there.
notifications_text: Get new messages even when MailChat is closed. Messages arrive encrypted inside the notification and are decrypted on this device.
notifications_blocked: Notifications are blocked for MailChat. Allow them in your browser or phone settings.
key_changed_text: MailChat got a different key for {{address}} than the one pinned on this device. Someone may be intercepting your messages. Compare fingerprints with them before you continue.
trust_new_key: I checked it, trust the new key
fingerprint_hint: Compare fingerprints in person or on a call to make sure nobody swapped keys.
export_backup_text: Download your private key, encrypted with a passphrase, to use MailChat on another device. Without it, losing this device means losing access to your messages.
backup_saved: Backup downloaded. Keep the file and the passphrase in separate places.
local_only_note: Chats are stored only on this device. The server keeps a message only as ciphertext, and only until your device confirms it got it.
remove_device_key_confirm: This deletes your private key and every chat on this device. Without a key backup you can't read new messages anywhere. Continue?
error_invalid_input: Check the fields and try again
error_username_taken: This login is taken. Try another one.
error_not_approved: Your account is waiting for approval
error_too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a bit and try again.
error_user_not_found: No MailChat user with this name
error_delivery_failed: Couldn't deliver the message. Tap Retry.
error_push_not_configured: Notifications aren't set up on this server yet
error_open_invalid: This isn't a valid MailChat message
error_wrong_account: This message was sent to {{address}}. Sign in to that account to read it.
error_decrypt_failed: The message couldn't be decrypted. It may be damaged, or not encrypted for your key.
error_envelope_mismatch: The sender or recipient of this message was tampered with
error_backup_invalid: This isn't a valid MailChat key backup
error_backup_other_account: This backup belongs to a different account
error_passphrase_too_short: The passphrase must be at least 10 characters
push_open_to_load: New encrypted message. Open MailChat to load it.
push_check_contact: New message. Open MailChat to check this contact.
install_before_register: On iPhone, add MailChat to your Home Screen first (Share › Add to Home Screen), then open it from the icon and create your account there. Otherwise your key stays in Safari.
login_hint: 3–32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. It becomes your address on this server.
offline_text: Type your message below, then tap here to encrypt it and send it through any app that still works: email, another messenger, SMS. Your contact pastes it into MailChat › Open message.
backup_missing: Tap “Choose the backup file” first, or paste the backup text
backup_paste_missing: Paste the backup text into the box above first
backup_in_passphrase: That was the backup text, so it’s now in the right box. Enter the passphrase you chose for the backup.
